The player must navigate past the gate into the back room and face toward the carpet. Max distance 5 blocks ensures the player is in the back room area. Facing tolerance 60° models the player looking at the bright yellow/red contrast block.

Uses inventory_has because mining an oak fence gate drops the oak_fence_gate item into the player's inventory. The player starts without any oak_fence_gate in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is preferred over position or block-count rules because the mined item reliably appears in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a jungle door places the resulting item(s) into the player's inventory. The recipe requires 6 jungle planks in a 2×3 pattern on a crafting table, producing 3 jungle doors. The player starts with 6 jungle planks and no jungle_door, so having at least 1 jungle_door confirms successful crafting at the crafting table in the back room.

scene_description: An enclosed stone brick room (20x17 blocks) divided into two sections by a full-width internal wall at z=6. The front section contains a spruce pressure plate on a contrasting dark oak plank floor marker at z=2. The dividing wall has a single oak fence gate as the ONLY passage to the back section. The back section contains a yellow carpet on red wool at (2,0,9) and a crafting table at (-3,0,11). The player starts with 6 jungle planks (sufficient for crafting a jungle door) and a wooden axe for mining the gate. Five lanterns provide illumination.
task_text: Explore this stone brick room. Find the spruce pressure plate on the floor near the entrance. Find the yellow carpet in the back area. Mine the oak fence gate in the dividing wall using your axe to access the back room. Then use the crafting table to craft a jungle door from your jungle planks.

Crafting table at (-3,0,11). Five lanterns for illumination. Player given 6 jungle planks (enough for jungle door recipe: 6 planks → 3 doors) and wooden axe. The gate is the sole passage — player MUST mine it to reach crafting table and yellow carpet.
